part.text:
Fixed. In `src/Illuminate/Support/Stringable.php:1100`, the `trimEnds` regex character class now includes `\x{0000}` (null byte), so `Str::trim`/`ltrim`/`rtrim` handle null bytes consistently with PHP's native `trim`, `ltrim`, and `rtrim`.

Verified with the existing tests:
- `SupportStrTest` trim/ltrim/rtrim tests (104 assertions, including the null-byte cases) — all pass
- `SupportStringableTest` — passes except a pre-existing `testIs` error caused by a missing test stub, unrelated to this change (fails on the unmodified tree too)
